# US-005: Record the round change log

## User Story

As a Leap Up member, I want to record what changed in each round, so that the client sees how feedback was handled.

## Context

ROUND CHANGE LOG (L169–L193).

## Linked Requirements

| FR | Priority | Notes |
|----|----------|-------|
| [FR-video-review-012](../srs/video-review-spec.md#3-functional-requirements-fr) | P0 | Round change log |

## Acceptance Criteria

<!-- DRAFT — generated by /ac from the draft SRS · AC must be confirmed by PO/QA before it is final -->

### AC-001 — Log shown per round

- **Type:** happy-path
- **Covers:** FR-video-review-012
- **Screen:** video-review

```gherkin
Given round 1 has change line "Initial cut shared" and status line "Client feedback collected" (board L187, L191)
When Video Review opens
Then the Round Change Log shows both lines under Round 1
```

Which status lines the log may show in Phase 1 (board L192 "Awaiting client approval" is Outcome Approval, P2):
**blocked by spec OQ-13**.

### AC-002 — Record a change

- **Type:** happy-path · **blocked by spec OQ-5** (who records the log, and how)
- **Covers:** FR-video-review-012

```gherkin
Given round 2 has no change line
When {a role allowed by OQ-5} records "Opening shortened; music adjusted" for round 2
Then the Round Change Log shows it under Round 2
```

### AC-003 — Round without a log entry

- **Type:** edge
- **Covers:** FR-video-review-012

```gherkin
Given round 3 has no change line
When Video Review opens
Then the Round Change Log shows no line under Round 3 (empty-state wording TBD)
```
